notes.title: Big Update!
notes.content:
[b][u]New Content:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] New hard mode
[*] 13 new patient conditions to assess 
[*] Can now receive letters from past patients and their family members
[/list]

[b][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Ms. Whisker's tail not showing up during the execution scene
[*] Ellington's forged document no longer flies away under certain circumstances
[*] Typos fixed
[*] Fixed some stamping issues
[*] Fixed bug with movement (Hopefully) 
[/list]

[b][u]Comments From The Dev:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Hope everyone enjoys!
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes + Important note
notes.content:
-A couple bug fixes here and there

[h1]Important Note [/h1]
Some players are experiencing a bug where they don't receive the priority list on the first day of getting the new priority stamper. After that, patient documents will not appear. I'm still working on solving this, but if you are experiencing this bug there is a temporary fix of just letting the day run out of time. After that, the game should continue normally.
